description: Call this when choosing among sellers for a task, or when the user asks for a safe or reliable API. Returns sellers with zero failures across at least 30 paid calls, most-called first. For each: domain, category, paid-call count, the 95% upper bound on its failure rate, median quoted price in USDC, USDC paid to it in the last 30 days, when it was last seen, and its paidfor seller page.

category.description: Kind of service to list sellers for; omit to list every kind

limit.description: How many sellers to return, most-called first; 50 when omitted

name: list_reliable_sellers

failure_rate_upper_bound.description: 95% interval upper bound on the failure rate

title: List reliable pay-per-call API sellers
